### Surrender Will Lead You to the Will of God
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-july-7-2012.html
Passage: John 7:17
Points:
- Unconditional surrender is the foundational principle for discovering and understanding God's will.
- Many believers struggle to discern God's path because they fear letting go of their personal rights and ambitions.
- God does not reveal His direction to those who want to evaluate His plans before deciding whether to obey.
- Spiritual clarity requires an advance commitment to go anywhere, do anything, and give up all rights for Christ.

### Power Point - Feb. 22, 2007
Author: Jack Graham (PowerPoint Ministries)
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-feb-22-2007-11530186.html
Passage: John 7:17
Points:
- Recognizing the divine truth of Jesus and His teachings is fundamentally an issue of the heart rather than intellect.
- God faithfully reveals the truth to anyone who genuinely desires to do His will.
- Waiting to resolve every intellectual reservation can prevent a person from ever coming to faith.
- Honest seekers should ask Jesus to reveal Himself and examine the evidence of who He is.
- Countless transformed lives testify that Jesus is neither a deceiver nor a lunatic, but Lord.

### The Way to Knowledge
Author: Oswald Chambers
Site: My Utmost for His Highest
URL: https://utmost.org/updated/the-way-to-knowledge/
Passage: John 7:17
Points:
- Spiritual understanding of Christ’s teaching is gained through active obedience rather than intellectual curiosity.
- Spiritual darkness in a person's life typically arises from an area of deliberate disobedience rather than a lack of knowledge.
- Whenever God reveals a truth, our willingness to obey is immediately put to the test.
- Attempting to evade scriptural conviction prevents spiritual maturity and leads to spiritual pretense.
- Entering deeper into the Kingdom requires total surrender and prompt compliance with God's directives.
